**Germany: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 4,892,322 applications. The largest annual volume was 745,510 in 2016; 2025 recorded 338,233. Applications in 2025 were 104% higher than in 2019 (165,868). In 2025, 418,777 recorded decisions equated to 124 per 100 applications, so recorded output exceeded incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 6.7% lower than in 2024 (362,538). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 1 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Afghanistan (87,715), Türkiye (59,455), Syrian Arab Rep. (41,266).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 34%, across 279,201 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 33% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 19.5 percentage points lower than in 2024 (53%).
